en.headline: Airport Authority option on New World shares faces dilution risk from rights issue
en.dek: Analysts say the authority’s right to buy 750 million shares at HK$3 each, granted in the 11 Skies handover, could lose value after New World’s heavily discounted capital raising.
body: Analysts have warned that New World Development’s proposed rights issue could reduce the value of an option held by the Airport Authority to purchase 750 million shares in the developer at HK$3 each.

The option formed part of the September agreement under which New World returned the 11 Skies retail and entertainment project near the airport to the authority. The Airport Authority has not confirmed whether the agreement includes an anti-dilution provision, and the detail is not stated in earlier exchange filings.

New World earlier announced a rights issue offering 11 new shares for every existing share at 90 Hong Kong cents, a steep discount to recent trading prices. The company said proceeds would be used mainly to reduce debt. The authority declined to comment on the anti-dilution question when asked by reporters.

Market observers noted that any substantial increase in the number of shares could affect the economics of the option unless protective terms were included. The authority has previously described the 11 Skies arrangement as allowing it to advance the project without a prolonged dispute.

zh.headline: 機管局認購新世界期權或因供股而攤薄
zh.dek: 分析指機管局以每股3元購入7.5億股的期權，可能因新世界大幅折讓供股而價值受影響，當局未確認有否反攤薄條款。
body: 分析員警告，新世界發展擬進行的供股可能令機場管理局以每股3港元購入7.5億股的期權價值下降。
該期權是九月協議的一部分，新世界將機場附近的11 SKIES零售及娛樂項目交還機管局。機管局未有確認協議是否包含反攤薄條款，而早前交易所文件亦未載有相關細節。
新世界早前公布供股，每持有一股現有股份可認購11股新股，認購價為0.9港元，較近期股價大幅折讓。公司表示集資所得主要用於減債。記者查詢時，機管局未有就反攤薄問題作出回應。
市場觀察者指出，除非有保護條款，否則股份數量大幅增加可能影響期權的經濟效益。機管局此前形容11 SKIES安排讓其可推進項目，而無需經歷漫長爭議。
